input: Build a LAMMPS data file for the tobermorite 11 Å rectangular (orthogonal) cell from the INTERFACE FF 1.5 model database (tob11_rectangular_cell) with the PCFF-INTERFACE force field (pcff_interface_v1_5.frc): atom_style full, real units, periodic in x, y and z, all force-field coefficients and masses written in the data file, triclinic tilt within LAMMPS's documented bound.
